description: data/questions.js — the QUESTIONS array. Options are shuffled on screen in every mode, so correct may sit at any index. Write distractors the same length as the key: if the correct answer is usually the longest option, the bank teaches test-taking, not the topic (validate.mjs measures this).

cert.description: Track id from topic.js. Optional when the topic has one track.

diff.description: Optional Endless-mode difficulty 1-5. When absent, the engine auto-tags from the stem.

duty.description: Blueprint duty letter (from dossier duties), when the topic has duties.

task.description: Blueprint task id such as B3, from the dossier task list.

title: Question bank
